findings.reason: diff.patch drops `date &&`, and since typeof null === "object" the `constructFromSymbol in date` check now runs on null and throws. The trigger is traced: normalizeDates/index.ts:25-27 binds constructFrom to `dates.find(d => typeof d === "object")`, so a call like differenceInCalendarDays(null, new Date()) passes null and now crashes where it used to return a value. Kept at high (Codex said medium) because this public call path is reachable.
findings.claim: Removing the `date &&` guard makes constructFrom throw a TypeError on a null reference date instead of falling through to `new Date(value)`.
findings.evidence: The diff changes `if (date && typeof date === "object" && constructFromSymbol in date)` to `if (typeof date === "object" && constructFromSymbol in date)`; `typeof null === "object"`, so `constructFromSymbol in null` runs and throws. The trigger is in `src/_lib/normalizeDates/index.ts:25-27`, which binds `constructFrom.bind(null, dates.find((date) => typeof date === "object"))`. That `find` returns `null` when any argument is null, so a call like `differenceInCalendarDays(new Date(), null)` (src/differenceInCalendarDays/index.ts:48) now throws where it used to build plain Dates. `constructNow` (src/constructNow/index.ts:36, `constructFrom(date, Date.now())`) and the `constructFrom(options?.in || date, date)` callers (e.g. src/isThisMonth/index.ts:35) take the same path. Nothing else in constructFrom stops a null before the `in` check; the guard was the only protection.

findings.reason: A grep for `null` in src/constructFrom/test.ts finds nothing. Only `undefined` and other inputs are tested, so the one input the removed guard handled is not covered.
findings.claim: No test covers a null reference date, so the suite does not catch the regression.
findings.evidence: src/constructFrom/test.ts covers a Date, a number, a custom Date subclass, `undefined` (line 52, 'allows to pass undefined') and a context function, but has no case for `null`. A grep of the test files finds no null-argument test that runs through normalizeDates or constructNow either. The one input the removed guard handled is untested.
